hook.name: ILAwareLimitOrderHook
hook.description: On-chain limit order hook for Uniswap v4 that maintains a sorted doubly-linked list of active tick positions per pool. Executes limit orders in afterSwap when the pool price crosses user-defined trigger thresholds, deducts a configurable execution fee (default 5 BPS), and represents each order as an ERC721 NFT.
